description.p: An authentic, native open-source Jagex Launcher for Linux designed to replicate the official Windows and macOS client experience with zero Wine or Proton overhead.

ul.li: Native 64-bit execution for RuneScape 3 using official Linux binaries with full hardware acceleration.
Integrated Old School RuneScape multi-client switcher supporting RuneLite, HDOS, and the official client.
One-click launch for RuneScape: Dragonwilds with live Steam RSS patch feeds.
Direct Jagex Account OAuth 2.0 PKCE authentication with built-in Cloudflare Turnstile handling.
Preserves local ~/.runelite configuration, plugins, screenshots, and bank tags.
Zero RAM mode automatically closes the launcher after game start to optimize memory.
Optional Feral GameMode (gamemoderun) and MangoHud overlay toggles.

screenshot.caption: Old School RuneScape view with RuneLite and HDOS client selection

description.p: Comprehensive internal auto-updater overhaul with dynamic package format selection, safe atomic in-place AppImage updates, native package manager integration for RPM, Pacman, DEB, and Snap, and automated Snap Store publishing pipeline.

Package upgrade compatibility fixes declaring Replaces, Conflicts, and Provides between jagex-launcher and linux-jagex-launcher, Arch User Repository binary path and symlink fixes, and release version synchronization across all packaging formats.

HiDPI display scaling controls for OSRS (1.0x to 3.0x), multi-instance client manager with live heartbeat and stop controls, in-app live client log viewer with ANSI styling and token redaction, multi-GPU and dedicated GPU selection (DRI PRIME and NVIDIA offload), custom launch command template expansion fixes, deep link OAuth protocol callback completion, PID recycling process safeguards, and harmless desktop subsystem warning classifications.

AppImage child environment sanitization preventing RuneLite re-exec loops, enhanced RuneLite and OSRS process lifecycle tracking with successor process migration, OpenJDK 24+ ZGC compatibility, static FUSE2-free AppImage runtime for Ubuntu 24.04/26.04, single-instance window focus restoration, Wayland display presentation fallbacks, official Old School RuneScape client integration modal, interactive play state unlock, and official Canonical Snap distribution pipeline with 3:1 store banners.
Hotfix resolving Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 t64 transitional package dependencies, Launchpad PPA rate-limiting cooldown and retry resiliency, and official website layout enhancements.

Native Linux system tray integration with instant character launch menus, Quick Shortcuts and Client Folders Hub (screenshots, logs, and cache for RS3, RuneLite, and HDOS), desktop shortcuts and application icon re-registration, official Launchpad Ubuntu PPA distribution, and enhanced AppStream metadata compliance.

Live World Ping Prober with visual latency badges and world hopping, Community Resources & Tools hub for RS3, OSRS, and Dragonwilds (including RuneKit and alt1-electron), Low-Spec / Older Linux Hardware fallback mode (Mesa/DRI overrides and JVM tuning), and contextual settings navigation.

Steam Deck turnkey installer with native shortcuts.vdf registration, multi-account profile switcher, Mesa Threaded OpenGL optimizations, human-readable release notes, and universal modal keyboard navigation.

Steam Deck & SteamOS handheld enhancements with full gamepad navigation, multi-account profile switching, Mesa Threaded OpenGL optimizations, automated RS3 Doctor diagnostics, and integrated auto-updater.
Initial stable release of the Linux Jagex Launcher featuring RS3 native support, RuneLite/HDOS integration, and Dragonwilds launching.
